parts.text: How much does Neon Drift Racers cost, and who developed it?
Neon Drift Racers costs €19.99 and was developed by Velocity Forge.
Which game do players complain about most when it comes to disconnects and netcode problems?
Star Salvage Crew — players report desync, rubber-banding, disconnects and failed host migrations in its multiplayer.

parts.text: Players say Silent Depths corrupts save files — did the developers ever fix that, and when?

Yes. The developers fixed the save-corruption bug issue in v1.2.0 version on January 15, 2026 (g12-patch-notes.md). Summary of the Fix: "Fixed an issue where save files could become corrupted under certain conditions." Backups Added: The patch also added an automatic backup system to prevent future save corruption. Recovery for Older Saves: Players with corrupted saves prior to the patch can restore from backups created by the game before the corruption occurred. Player evidence and reports confirm that the issue has been resolved in the latest version. Before the fix, players reported that save files would become corrupted when the game crashed during a save operation. After the patch, players have reported that their saves are now stable and no longer experience corruption.
